notes: Fiscal year runs Aug 1-Jul 31, on deal close date (not the Oct-Sep close year used elsewhere for monthly win-rate). 'Generated' = SUM(amount) across ALL deals (open + won + lost, both pipelines, single-site included) whose closedate falls in the window -- lost deals count toward the goal number, since $10M pipeline / $2M closed-won implies a ~20% target win rate. reference_year is informational only (last completed year, for comparison) and is not re-fetched automatically. Edit pipeline_goal / closed_won_goal / window_start / window_end here directly when the target changes -- no code change needed. Read (not written) by weekly-marketing-digest and monthly-marketing-digest.
